name: MovieLens 1M Dataset
description: A benchmark dataset of approximately one million ratings from 6,040 users on 3,900 movies, collected by the GroupLens Research Project. Ratings are on a five-star scale and include timestamps and user/movie metadata.
citation: Harper, F. M., & Konstan, J. A. (2015). The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems, 5(4), Article 19. https://doi.org/10.1145/2827872
